POST /users.summary: Create staff, coach, manager or member account (MEMBER creates the member profile too)

POST /subscriptions.summary: Register member to a membership plan

GET /subscriptions/member/{memberId}.summary: Get all subscriptions for a member

PATCH /subscriptions/{id}/status.summary: Cập nhật trạng thái gói (Manager only)

PATCH /subscriptions/{id}/cancel.summary: Member tự hủy gói của mình

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Subscription ID (phải là gói của chính mình)

reason.description: Lý do hủy gói (không bắt buộc)
reason.example: Tôi không có thời gian tập luyện nữa

GET /reports/revenue.summary: Revenue report (total, by method, recent payments)

GET /reports/members.summary: Member report (total, new, active, by tier)

GET /reports/memberships.summary: Membership subscription report (by status, tier, revenue)

POST /payments.summary: Record a payment (auto-creates invoice on SUCCESS)

GET /members/{id}.summary: Get member by ID (userId or profileId)

GET /members/{id}/membership-status.summary: Get member effective tier and active subscription

GET /invoices/member/{memberId}.summary: Get invoices for a specific member

POST /feedbacks.summary: Member gửi đánh giá cho HLV

comment.example: HLV rất nhiệt tình, hướng dẫn chi tiết và dễ hiểu!

isAnonymous.description: Ẩn tên khi hiển thị công khai

GET /feedbacks.summary: Xem danh sách đánh giá của một HLV (public)

parameters.name: coachId
parameters.description: CoachProfile ID cần xem đánh giá

parameters.name: classId
parameters.description: Lọc theo lớp học cụ thể (tuỳ chọn)

GET /feedbacks/my.summary: Member xem danh sách feedback mình đã gửi

POST /enrollments.summary: Book a class (Member books own class; Staff/Manager book for a member)

GET /enrollments/schedule/{scheduleId}.summary: Get all enrollments for a schedule

GET /classes/{id}.summary: View class details (includes coaches and upcoming schedules)

POST /classes/{id}/coaches.summary: Assign coach to class (Sends COACH_CHANGED notification to enrolled members)

DELETE /classes/{id}/coaches/{coachId}.summary: Remove coach from class (Sends COACH_CHANGED notification to enrolled members)

POST /class-schedules.summary: Create a new schedule (checks room & coach conflicts)

PATCH /class-schedules/{id}.summary: Update schedule (re-checks conflicts if room/time changed)

status.description: If set to CANCELLED, all BOOKED enrollments are cancelled automatically

DELETE /class-schedules/{id}.summary: Cancel schedule (automatically cancels all BOOKED enrollments)

POST /auth/login.summary: Login and receive access + refresh tokens

POST /auth/refresh-token.summary: Get a new access token using a refresh token

POST /attendance/generate-qr.summary: Generate a short-lived QR token for attendance (Coach/Manager only)

POST /attendance/scan-qr.summary: Scan a QR token to mark self as PRESENT (Member only)

qrToken.description: JWT token from QR code shown by Coach
